column1: # Ash Jenna's two fights: the optional super boss in Vale and the one at Suhalla Gate.

column3:
You came back, Isaac.
I wondered whether
you'd have the nerve.{page_break}This is where you
grew up, isn't it?
Such a quiet place.{page_break}I fought in another
world once. They were
just as sure as you.{end_wait}
You've hurt enough\npeople already.\nWhy come to Vale?{end_wait}

Because it's yours.
I wanted to see what
you'd do to keep it.{page_break}You can walk away.
But you'll know I was
here, waiting.{end_wait}

You won this time.
Go home, Isaac.
Tell them you're safe.{page_break}Then ask yourself
who'll be here when
you leave again.{end_wait}

Look at these soldiers.
All that courage,
and none of it mattered.{page_break}I could finish them.
But watching you choose
who to save is better.{end_wait}

Get away from them.
Your fight is with me.{page_break}You want me to choose
who gets left behind.
I know your game.{end_wait}

Oh, Isaac. You still
think you get to
make the rules?{page_break}Then come closer.
Let's see how many
more I can break.{end_wait}

You beat me, Isaac.
Does that make you
feel like a hero?{page_break}Those men are still
bleeding. Go on.
Save them.{page_break}I'll remember how
easy you are to hurt.{end_wait}
